prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: A Note App That Keeps Up With Your Thoughts
plan.description: A 30-second launch video for a note-taking app that captures ideas fast and helps you find them later. Capture, organize and search your notes in one calm place.

beats.narration: Your best idea just vanished. It was on a sticky note, or in a chat, or nowhere at all.
Meet our new note-taking app. Jot down your thoughts and keep them in one place.
Find any note when you need it. Your ideas stay organized, so you can stop remembering and start creating.
Keep your thoughts within reach. Download the app and write it down.

warnings: length: the narration totals 68 words in 4 beats but a 30-second video needs about 58 (between 52 and 58). Cut about 10 words: 3 to 4 beats of about 19 words each (you averaged 17; count the words of every beat), one idea, no preamble and no recap; keep the hook and the last line
grounding: 3 beats had unsupported specifics, 3 rewritten
